payload.Instructions: Add the white rum to a highball glass. Add 8  10 mint leaves and sugar syrup and lime juice. Muddle with bar spoon. Add crushed ice and a splash of soda. Mix drink down with bar spoon. Taste. Top up with more crushed ice. Slap 2 mint sprigs to release essence and put into drink. Add small splash of soda and straw.
Muddle the Lime and Mint and Sugar Syrup in a Highball Glass. Add the Rum, crushed ice, and churn. Add a crushed ice cap. Top with Soda. Garnish with a Mint Sprig and Lime Wedge.
payload.Utensils: 1 Highball glass|1 Jigger|1 Ice Scoop|1 Muddler|1 Bar Spoon|1 Tongs

payload.Instructions: Add Rum, mint, simple syrup, lime juice, and ice to a cocktail shaker. Shake until combined. Add club soda to shaker and stir. Pour the cocktail into a Collins glass. Add a lime slice for garnish, if desired.

Muddle the lime wedges, sugar, and mint leaves in a shaker until the sugar is dissolved. Add ice and rum, shake just a few times to mix, and strain into an ice-filled glass. Top with sparkling water, slap a sprig of mint and garnish the drink with it, along with fresh lime slices and more mint leaves arranged artfully inside the glass.
Muddle mint leaves with sugar and lime juice. Add a splash of soda water and fill the glass with cracked ice. Pour the rum and top with soda water. Garnish and serve with straw.

Lightly muddle the mint with the simple syrup in a shaker. Add the rum, lime juice and ice, and give it a brief shake, then strain into a highball glass over fresh ice. Alternatively, you can use pebble ice instead and gently swizzle it all together. Top with the club soda. Garnish with a mint sprig and lime wheel.

Put 3 mint leaves and 2 teaspoons sugar into each of 2 glass tumblers; vigorously stir sugar and mint together, crushing mint with the back of a spoon to release oils.Add 3 lime wedges to each glass; again stir vigorously to release some lime juice.Pour 1 jigger rum into each glass, then fill glasses with ice cubes. Top with carbonated water; stir.
Muddle mint sprigs in a glass with sugar and lime juice. Add rum and top up with Champagne. Garnish with sprig of mint leaves. Serve with a straw.

Squeeze and add the lime wedges into an old-fashioned glass. Add the mint leaves and garnish with mint leaves on the stem. Fill the glass with ice. Make Simple Syrup: Add the sugar and soda water to create a simple syrup. Use a large wooden spoon to crush and infuse the ingredients together. Pour in the silver rum and give it a gentle stir.

Fill a highball glass with ice. Pick some fresh mint leaves, tear them in half, place them on the palm of your hand, and clap the mint to release the aroma. Add to the glass. Add 1 oz lime juice, 0.75 oz sugar syrup, and 2 oz white rum to the glass. Top with a splash of soda water. Stir thoroughly to mix all the ingredients. Serve immediately and enjoy your Easy Mojito Cocktail.
In the container of a blender, combine the lemonade concentrate, lemon-lime soda, rum and strawberries. Cover, and blend until smooth. Add ice and blend to desired thickness.

Chill coupe glass with soda water. Add sugar to mixing tin and then add white rum and lime juice. Add a little cracked ice to the bottom then fill the rest of the tin with ice. Shake for 10  15 seconds, taste and then fine strain into coupe glass. Garnish glass with lime slice.
Combine all ingredients, except lime wedge, in a shaker. Add ice and shake vigorously, until tin is frosted over. Strain cocktail into a chilled coupe glass. Garnish with a lime wedge and enjoy.
Shake all the liquid ingredients with ice. Fine strain into a chilled Coupette Glass. Garnish with a lime twist.
payload.Utensils: 1 Coupette Glass|1 Ice Scoop|1 Jigger|1 Cocktail Shaker|1 Hawthrone Strainer|1 Fine Strainer|1 Tongs

payload.Instructions: Pour all ingredients into a shaker tin and add ice. Shake hard until well-chilled. Fine strain into a coupe glass. Garnish with a lime wheel on the surface of the cocktail.
Combine the lime juice and sugar in a shaker. Stir until the sugar is dissolved. Add the rum and fill the shaker with ice. Shake and strain into a coupe glass.
Shake with ice and strain into an ice-filled glass or a chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with a wedge or wheel of lime.
Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled cocktail glass.
Add the rum, lime juice and demerara sugar syrup to a shaker with ice, and shake until well-chilled. Double strain through fine mesh strainer into a chilled coupe. Garnish with a lime twist.
Combine light rum, lime juice, and simple syrup in a cocktail shaker. Add ice, cover and shake until chilled. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
